Class DataManager

java.lang.Object
utility.DataManager
public class DataManager extends Object
Handles loading and searching of user, venue, and event data. Reads CSV files and stores records in HashMaps for efficient lookup.

  • Method Details

    • findUsers

      public List<User> findUsers(HashMap<String,User> userMap, String query)
      Searches the user map for users matching the given query. Lookup priority is: numeric ID first, then exact username match, then case-insensitive full name match.
      Parameters:
      userMap - the map of username to User to search
      query - the search term (numeric ID, username, or "First Last")
      Returns:
      a list of matching User objects; empty if none found

    • findVenues

      public List<Venue> findVenues(HashMap<Integer,Venue> venueMap, String query)
      Searches the venue map for venues matching the given query. Lookup priority is: numeric ID first, then case-insensitive name match, then case-insensitive type match.
      Parameters:
      venueMap - the map of venue ID to Venue to search
      query - the search term (numeric ID, venue name, or venue type)
      Returns:
      a list of matching Venue objects; empty if none found

    • findEvents

      public List<Event> findEvents(HashMap<Integer,Event> eventMap, String query)
      Searches the event map for events matching the given query. Lookup priority is: numeric ID first, then case-insensitive name match, then case-insensitive date match.
      Parameters:
      eventMap - the map of event ID to Event to search
      query - the search term (numeric ID, event name, or date string)
      Returns:
      a list of matching Event objects; empty if none found

    • loadUsers

      public HashMap<String,User> loadUsers(String fileName)
      Reads a CSV file of users and populates a map keyed by username. Parses the header row dynamically to determine column positions, so the CSV columns can be in any order. Also tracks the highest user ID seen to support unique ID generation.
      Parameters:
      fileName - path to the CSV file containing user records
      Returns:
      a HashMap mapping username to the corresponding User object

    • loadEvents

      public HashMap<Integer,Event> loadEvents(String fileName, HashMap<Integer,Venue> venueMap)
      Reads a CSV file of events and populates a map keyed by event ID. Parses the header row dynamically to determine column positions, so the CSV columns can be in any order. If a "Venue ID" column is present, seat counts are computed automatically from the linked venue's capacity and seat percentages. Also tracks the highest event ID seen to support unique ID generation.
      Parameters:
      fileName - path to the CSV file containing event records
      venueMap - the loaded venue map used to compute seat counts from venue data
      Returns:
      a HashMap mapping event ID to the corresponding Event object

    • loadVenues

      public HashMap<Integer,Venue> loadVenues(String fileName)
      Reads a CSV file of venues and populates a map keyed by venue ID. Parses the header row dynamically to determine column positions, so the CSV columns can be in any order. Also tracks the highest venue ID seen to support unique ID generation.
      Parameters:
      fileName - path to the CSV file containing venue records
      Returns:
      a HashMap mapping venue ID to the corresponding Venue object

    • resolveEvent

      public Event resolveEvent(HashMap<Integer,Event> eventMap, String query, Scanner in) throws EventNotFoundException
      Searches for an event matching the query and prompts the user to disambiguate if multiple matches are found.
      Parameters:
      eventMap - the map of event ID to Event
      query - the search term (numeric ID, event name, or date)
      in - the Scanner for user input when disambiguation is needed
      Returns:
      the matched Event
      Throws:
      EventNotFoundException - if no event matches the query

    • writeCustomerHistory

      public void writeCustomerHistory(String fileName, int userID, String eventType, String eventName, String eventDate, String ticketType, int numOfTickets, double totalCost, int confirmNum)
      Writes a customer's purchase transaction to the order history CSV file.
      Parameters:
      fileName - the path to the CSV file
      userID - the customer's ID
      eventType - the type of event (Sport, Concert, Special)
      eventName - the name of the event
      eventDate - the date of the event
      ticketType - the type of ticket purchased (VIP, Gold, Silver, Bronze, General Admission)
      numOfTickets - the number of tickets purchased
      totalCost - the total cost charged to the customer
      confirmNum - the confirmation number for this transaction
